receipts.message: First radish planted — five real minutes. Later radishes take thirty. The committee has approved having roots.
Soil checked, leaves admired. No speed or yield bonus — just a well-informed gardener.
Three addressed parcels accepted. No bag space, payment or deadline. The route is circular. For once, this is intentional.
Annual leave for a tree. I have approved the branching arrangement. Receipt kept.
Bound hand saw received. Equip it explicitly to prepare fallen pine. Certified to divide one problem into two smaller problems.
Hand saw equipped. Fallen pine can now be prepared; no output multiplier.
Prepared 6 pine. 6/24 carried. The three deadfall points share one personal supply; other residents keep theirs.
A permit for a form. At last, a form with a future. Receipt kept.
The grass is growing. Management has asked it to be more specific. Receipt kept.
Route card and letterbox plan saved. Everything arrived. The town is choosing to regard this as a precedent. A physical letterbox is optional and made separately.
Gathered 6 scrap. 0 left in the bin.
Gathered 6 timber. 0 left in the bin.
Gathered 6 supplies. 0 left in the bin.
Optimistic planter started. Materials spent: 2 scrap, 2 timber, 1 supplies.
Collected one optimistic planter. +1 Making experience.
Optimistic planter placed. No materials spent.
Bridge repair kit started. Materials spent: 3 scrap, 2 timber, 1 supplies.
Harvested one produce and returned one bound seed. Promoted to vegetable management.
Made one Unreasonably Official Letterbox: 2 pine + 1 radish spent once. No new timer or production bonus. Motif changes and moving this same item are free.
Unreasonably Official Letterbox placed. No materials spent.
